title: Truenat and other mWRDs
dek: Xpert is not the only WHO-endorsed molecular WRD. Truenat MTB/MTB-RIF, TB-LAMP, and others occupy the same algorithm slot: detect MTBC, then rifampin, then follow-on DST.
story: WHO groups several technologies as molecular WHO-recommended rapid diagnostics (mWRDs) for pulmonary TB: Xpert Ultra, Truenat MTB and MTB-Plus with MTB-RIF Dx, and selected other NAATs. The public-health job is the same: same-day MTBC detection and a rifampin window, closer to the patient than a reference WGS bench.

Truenat is a chip-based, battery-tolerant platform used widely in India and expanding. Workflow is two-step: MTB detection, then RIF on positives. Error codes, inhibition, and “indeterminate RIF” exist here too. Do not treat a platform brand as a different biological target.
TB-LAMP detects MTBC without a RIF channel — it is a detection WRD, not a DST. Lateral-flow LAM is not an mWRD for MTBC DNA. Keep the vocabulary honest when you write an algorithm.
deep: A perfect cartridge in a clinic without sputum quality is still a bad test. Instruction plates belong next to the device.
WHO LOD and Se/Sp estimates are study-specific. Local PPV still follows prevalence.
Follow-on FQ/INH testing is independent of whether the first bell was Ultra or Truenat.
Connectivity (GxAlert-like) is operations, not a gene.

visual.caption: Any initial mWRD that finds MTBC should open a RIF window (if the device has one) and then the same follow-on DST spine.

example.title: Truenat MTB-positive, RIF indeterminate, no Xpert
example.setup: Peripheral site, Truenat MTB detected, RIF Dx indeterminate, no Ultra stock.

steps.title: Treat as bacteriologically confirmed TB
steps.body: Do not wait for a brand change to start DS therapy if RR is not shown.

steps.title: Repeat RIF channel or refer
steps.body: Indeterminate is not RR and not RIF-S. Get a second mWRD, LPA, tNGS, or culture.

steps.title: Same follow-on logic
steps.body: If RR later confirms, Xpert XDR/tNGS — not a different biology.

example.takeaway: mWRD is a class. Brand is logistics.

check.prompt: Truenat MTB/MTB-RIF sits in WHO algorithms as:
choices: An mWRD in the same slot as Xpert for detection ± RIF
check.answer: An mWRD in the same slot as Xpert for detection ± RIF

whyWrong.A serology test: WHO advises against commercial TB serology for diagnosis.

check.prompt: TB-LAMP compared with Ultra/Truenat RIF assays is missing:
check.why: LAMP is detection. RIF still needs another test.

whyWrong.Electricity always: LAMP is often billed as lower-infrastructure.
